title: Tech Note: 4D for iOS: User Signup & Custom Login Form
author: Nhat Do, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: On Mobile App Authentication / On Mobile App Action
Web-based signup form (WEB SEND FILE, On Web Connection)

historical_commentary.text: Obsolete as a product path: 4D discontinued the native 4D for iOS mobile app generator, so this specific Mobile Project workflow no longer applies; the underlying secure-signup/password-hashing and REST-filtering concepts remain valid but would now be implemented in a REST/ORDA web or PWA context instead.
related_updates: 4D discontinued its native 4D for iOS/Android mobile app generation product line; developers today build mobile-friendly experiences with responsive ORDA/REST-based web apps (and increasingly Qodly Studio) rather than 4D's native mobile project generator shown here.

The security practices demonstrated — hashing passwords rather than storing them in plaintext, excluding sensitive tables/fields from REST exposure, filtering data by authenticated user — remain sound, current best practice regardless of the specific (now-retired) delivery mechanism.
